seller.verification_method: found in our own persisted listings (17 rows captured incidentally by the Gate C auction run), then confirmed live: sellers:{4_sharp_corners} in category 212 returned 6,930 with no warning and every returned item carried that exact username

username_guessing_hazard.detail: an invalid username makes eBay emit warning 'A seller username provided in the request filters is invalid' and DROP the filter, returning the whole marketplace. Guesses '4-sharp-corners' and '4sharpcorners_' returned 106,013,379 and 106,949,727 items this way. Every probe was re-run through assert_query_accepted, which turns that into a hard failure.

reconnaissance.auction_anomaly: buyingOptions:{AUCTION} reported 14,435 against a 6,930 population with no warning - impossible for a subset. Disregarded in favour of mapped items: all 6,991 collected rows normalize to FIXED_PRICE_ONLY, so the seller is 100% fixed price.

collection.method: Browse item_summary/search, sellers + buyingOptions:{FIXED_PRICE}, leaf 261328, 200/page, offset paging

seller_specific_differences: 100% fixed price; the PSA store population is also fixed price, so the auction exclusion costs nothing here
every listing returns FIXED shipping with a value, so shipping_state is KNOWN on 6,991 of 6,991 - the PSA store sample was likewise all FIXED
parse success 84.5% vs 82.3% for the PSA store: the existing parser transfers without seller-specific rules
titles carry team names and RC/HOF tokens the PSA store often omits; slab_key already ignores them, confirmed by 96 identities matching the PSA store's Tier A keys across the two sellers
23 PSA AUTHENTIC listings exist and are excluded as non-numeric grades
no lots and no sets: leaf 261329 and 261330 both return 0

evidence_reuse_gate.rule: exact effective full slab_key equality against production tierb.effective_slab_key, deduplicated on unique comp identity, >=3 unique accepted priced comps, newest within 365 days

cross_check_looser_tier_a_match.note: reported only as a cross-check; the specified gate is the effective key and was not relaxed

blocker.statement: The seller is identified and the population is material - 5,873 eligible fixed-price graded singles across 5,872 unique slab identities, all USD with known shipping. The pilot cannot proceed as scoped because our sold-comp evidence base covers only 85 identities, all derived from the PSA store's re-keyed groups, and none of them appears in this seller's inventory. Phase 3 requires reusable evidence and forbids both new Product Research and evidence-poor fillers, so the cohort is empty.
blocker.not_a_defect: the gate behaved correctly; there is simply no intersection

isolation.production_reads: read-only URI connection for comp lookup
